issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves dependent task simultaneously completed and blocked
actual: Task 4 "Complete tax filing" was completed while its prerequisite (task 1) was also completed. Reopening task 1 (its only prerequisite) did NOT prevent the reopen and did NOT return task 4 to active/incomplete state. Task 4 remains listed in the Completed view (state=completed, counted in "3 completed") while simultaneously showing blocked-warning=true with message "Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete" and complete/edit disabled - an invalid combined completed+blocked state.

evidence: Completed tasks 1, 4, 6 remained visible and available in Completed view after completion (not deleted). Reopening task1 via its complete toggle moved it back to active view, confirming user control over completed/reopened state.

issue: Dependency connector lines are not reliably hoverable/interactive
actual: Found 4 dashed SVG connector paths (stroke-dasharray) wrapped in `<g class="pointer-events-auto cursor-pointer" data-state="closed">` groups with a wide (stroke-width:16) transparent hit path, intended to show a popup. However these elements report a zero-width bounding box (getBoundingClientRect w:0) causing Playwright's hover and click actions to time out with "element is not visible". Dispatching synthetic pointerover/pointerenter/mouseover/mouseenter events directly on the group also did not change data-state from "closed" to "open" nor reveal any dependency-chain content in the DOM. The connector is not exposed in the accessibility tree either. The hover-to-reveal dependency chain popup could not be triggered through any interaction method tested.

evidence: Hovering over "Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete" warning on task 7 triggered a tooltip titled "Dependency Chain" listing "Review project proposal - pending" and "Complete tax filing", correctly identifying the pending prerequisite chain.
